title: Check stored capture bytes
responsibility: Checks the stored capture’s size, hash and media type before returning its bytes.

inputs.name: artifactAnswer.capture
inputs.description: The listed capture’s kind, recorded media type, SHA-256 hash, stored-media marker and optional explanation for missing bytes.

inputs.name: artifactAnswer.bytes
inputs.description: The bytes held by the capture’s record, or undefined when unavailable. At most 11 MiB is accepted, including exactly 11 MiB.

outputs.name: artifactAnswer
outputs.description: A promise for the original bytes, their checked recorded hash, and the media type selected from the capture kind and byte signatures. Unsupported media is rejected by the media checker.

errors.name: not-stored
errors.description: Rejects when bytes are absent or the capture’s media marker is null. The message includes the recorded gap when available.

errors.name: too-large
errors.description: Rejects bytes longer than 11 MiB, reporting the actual and allowed lengths.

errors.name: hash-mismatch
errors.description: Rejects when hashing the supplied bytes with SHA-256 does not reproduce the recorded hash.
